main_measure.name: OLS slope of excess 3-bar return on forecast (non-overlapping grid, pooled)
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 confirms (with the supporting check), t <= -2 rejects, otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: forecast-weighted mean excess 3-bar return on grid bars with forecast > 0

decided_by: The slope's t is >= 2 and the forecast-weighted mean excess return on positive-forecast grid bars is above 0.
reading: Grid bars at positions 0, 3, 6, ... of each window, dropping those without a bar t+3 in the window; the coin's mean 3-bar return is the mean of its grid returns over all its windows; the slope is an OLS with intercept and its ordinary t; the 200 minimum counts grid bars with forecast > 0 and a valid 3-bar return and, as a minimum count, gives 'not observable' when not reached.
